title: Overlooked Safety Vulnerability in LLMs: Malicious Intelligent Optimization Algorithm Request and its Jailbreak
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its investigation. The research focuses on AI safety vulnerabilities in the context of automated algorithm design.
